Messages.Author: Marc Remillard
Messages.Body:
Weapon:

1R Aggravated damage each strike. Only usable once per combat. Only usable
at long range. The minion with this equipment may tap to give the acting
minion -1 stealth for the current action.

Q: If I am in combat using a minion with this card on, does that mean I can
use a combatcard, like Taste of Death, that gives 2R damage aggravated and
then once each combat I can choose to let the Starshell Grenade Launcher add
1R normal damage. If the opposing minion could not heal the normal damage
and prevent the agg.dam. he would be burned then?

Or is the equipment card a strike for it self?

Regards,
Peter.

It's a strike in itself. It does 1R agg each strike but you may only strike

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Marc Remillard wrote:
> 1R Aggravated damage each strike. Only usable once per combat. Only usable
> at long range. The minion with this equipment may tap to give the acting
> minion -1 stealth for the current action.
>
> Q: If I am in combat using a minion with this card on, does that mean I can
> use a combatcard, like Taste of Death, that gives 2R damage aggravated and
> then once each combat I can choose to let the Starshell Grenade Launcher add
> 1R normal damage.

No. It means that the Starshell Grenade Launcher does 1R agg damage each strike.
Each Starshell Grenade Launcher strike does 1R agg damage.
Other strikes are not affected.
